claudeAssist.budget.title: Isabelomali seseshini
claudeAssist.budget.hint: Ngomkhawulo obekiwe, sonke isicelo esithunyelwa ku-Claude siqhathaniswa nesabelomali esisele ngaphambi kokuba siphume. Uma singase seqe umkhawulo asithunyelwa futhi uyatshelwa ukuthi kungani. Ezingxoxweni zokusiza ungaqhubeka “okwalesi sikhathi esisodwa kuphela”; ezinye izici ze-AI ezifana nengxoxo zidinga umkhawulo uphakanyiswe noma ususwe. Inombolo yalo mkhawulo kuphela egcinwa kulesi siphequluli.
